summary: The selected .7-.11 programme continuation retains its sole owning plan, finite pilot history, delivered native inspection/selection and separate Observation-only/product contracts. Typed packaged migration source now includes exact original-path custody, private one-shot admission, fresh determining reads, bounded sender, expiry/barrier checks, strict envelopes and independent readback; whole source review closed seven findings, but its twenty-seven prepared controls and compiler/runtime behavior still require hosted qualification. No native migration, installed acceptance, coordinated consumer activation or manual-status retirement is selected. Root has selected the existing accessible developer installation as the .9 successor target and Home/SystemAdmin as its existing versioned coherent-release updater custodian. Observed 0.102/source6e9 bytes establish an old installation only; the actual successor executable/package, private reviewed binding, approved credential principal and current invocation remain unqualified. An unrelated protected telemetry Store is not established as a native-GitHub inspection prerequisite or as the Project 3 consumer identity. Source/byte candidate qualification can advance under its separate admission while original .103 attempted-Unknown/.104 held and original reservations remain untouched. The selected minimal .9 source extension reuses release-successor-candidate.yml and the same isolated installed tool; its current .103 profile, six feed/predecessor freshness reads and tag gates remain intact. Actual gate failure retains a gap and requires evidence/decision, never an automatic alternate profile. The existing strict seven-member publisher archive and release-successor-artifact verifier remain unchanged; packaged V2 control evidence belongs in a separately named source/run/attempt/package/member-bound artifact, which supplies no publication or activation authority. The normal Home updater still requires a genuinely promoted coherent channel and cannot activate an unpromoted candidate; no second installer, publisher workaround or authority service is selected. Actual private Project 3 reads use an explicitly selected approved local caller/environment and existing credential custody, not assumed repository Actions-token permissions. The CLI accepts GITHUB_TOKEN first, otherwise GH_TOKEN; it does not retrieve gh-auth credentials automatically. Controlled pre-migration refusal/read-only evidence and candidate installation are not complete board-composition acceptance. New In review IDs and final enrollment/binding remain unresolved until admitted native mutation and independent readback; only then can positive installed v4 inspection/refresh/selection and actual UI grouping/sort/order verification precede real-use consumer adoption. No public absence, candidate artifact, source merge or local cached package settles an uncertain original release.
title: Select existing receiver ownership while keeping candidate qualification and activation distinct
